name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
brief_description: Crispy roasted Brussels sprouts with balsamic glaze and crispy bacon.
ingredients: Brussels sprouts, olive oil, balsamic glaze, bacon, garlic, parmesan cheese
dietary_notes: Can be made vegetarian without bacon
content:
Roasted Brussels Sprouts - A Flavorful Favorite

Forget everything you thought you knew about Brussels sprouts. These crispy, caramelized sprouts will convert even the biggest skeptics.

The Preparation

We start with fresh Brussels sprouts, halved and tossed with olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. They're roasted at high heat until the edges are perfectly crispy and golden brown, while the centers remain tender.

The Finishing Touch

  • Balsamic Glaze - A sweet and tangy reduction that adds depth
  • Crispy Bacon - Smoky, salty bits that complement the sprouts
  • Parmesan Cheese - Freshly grated for a nutty finish

Why They're Special

The high-heat roasting process caramelizes the natural sugars in the Brussels sprouts, creating a sweet, nutty flavor that pairs perfectly with the tangy balsamic and salty bacon. It's a perfect balance of textures and flavors.

Perfect For

  • Sharing as an appetizer
  • A lighter side option
  • Vegetarian diners (when ordered without bacon)

name: Bacon Cheeseburger
brief_description: Classic burger topped with crispy bacon, melted cheddar cheese, and all the fixings.
ingredients: Beef patty, brioche bun, cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, lettuce, tomato, red onion, pickles, special sauce
dietary_notes: Can be made gluten-free with lettuce wrap
content:
Bacon Cheeseburger - A Classic Done Right

Everything you love about our classic burger, elevated with crispy bacon and melted cheddar cheese.

The Perfect Combination

Our hand-formed beef patty is topped with thick-cut, crispy bacon and melted sharp cheddar cheese. The combination of smoky bacon, creamy cheese, and juicy beef creates the ultimate burger experience.

The Build

  • Beef Patty - 6 oz hand-formed patty, cooked to order
  • Bacon - Thick-cut, crispy strips
  • Cheese - Sharp cheddar, melted to perfection
  • Bun - Toasted brioche bun, buttered and grilled
  • Toppings - Fresh lettuce, ripe tomato, red onion, and house-made pickles
  • Sauce - Our special sauce

Comes With

Choice of one side: hand-cut fries, roasted Brussels sprouts, coleslaw, or onion rings.

Why It's Special

The crispy bacon adds a smoky, salty crunch that perfectly complements the juicy beef and creamy cheese. It's a flavor combination that never gets old.

name: Hand-Cut French Fries
brief_description: Fresh-cut russet potatoes, double-fried for the perfect crispy exterior and fluffy interior.
ingredients: Russet potatoes, canola oil, sea salt
content:
Hand-Cut French Fries - Made Fresh Daily

These aren't frozen fries from a bag. We start with fresh russet potatoes and cut them by hand every morning, then double-fry them for the perfect texture.

The Process

We use only the best russet potatoes, cut them fresh daily, and soak them to remove excess starch. Then we double-fry them: first at a lower temperature to cook them through, then at a higher temperature to create that perfect golden, crispy exterior.

The Result

  • Crispy Exterior - Golden brown and perfectly crunchy
  • Fluffy Interior - Soft and tender on the inside
  • Sea Salt - Lightly seasoned with coarse sea salt

Why They're Special

The double-frying technique creates the perfect texture: crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside. Every batch is made fresh, so you get the best fries possible.

Perfect Pairing

These fries are the ideal companion to any of our burgers. They're also great on their own or with our house-made dipping sauces.

name: Beer-Battered Onion Rings
brief_description: Thick-cut onion rings in our house beer batter, fried to golden perfection.
ingredients: Sweet onions, beer batter, flour, spices
content:
Beer-Battered Onion Rings - Crispy and Golden

Our thick-cut onion rings are dipped in our signature beer batter made with our own craft beer, then fried until golden and crispy.

The Batter

We use our own craft beer in the batter, which adds a subtle flavor and creates an incredibly light, crispy coating. The batter is seasoned with our secret blend of spices for extra flavor.

The Onions

We use only sweet onions, cut thick to ensure they stay tender inside while the outside gets perfectly crispy. Each ring is hand-dipped to ensure even coverage.

The Result

  • Crispy Coating - Light, golden, and perfectly crunchy
  • Tender Inside - Sweet and soft onion that melts in your mouth
  • Perfect Size - Thick enough to have substance, not too thick to be overwhelming

Perfect Pairing

These onion rings are the perfect side for any burger, or great on their own with our house-made dipping sauces.
